/*
Pure mechanical final27/SPEC assembler for source1fa/run38015134511.
No tools, filesystem, compiler, tests, commits or ref operations.
Authentication of actual release/final33 bytes, envelopes, all existing required
observations (including log-only and current source-empty boundaries), provider
decisions and source/recipe identities is a caller precondition. The callback
resolves EXISTING authenticated receiptRefs to their exact ordered group IDs;
it neither constructs nor changes their stored wrapper schema.
Inputs:
  ledgerText = exact ceabd bytes.
  procedure = b8 + ab00 projected27 object.
  transport = c5 + 91ff projected transport object.
  correspondenceProcedure = 1e + 91ff projected33 procedure object.
  projectedRelease = e802 + f38 + ab00 projection BEFORE final c5/evidence fills.
  mapText/reviewText = exact697/f6cc bytes; specText = exact61f bytes.
  releaseText/releaseRef and correspondenceText/correspondenceRef = actual final
    authenticated documents, refs {path,blob,sha256,bytes}.
  evidence = {qualification,strictBinder,provider,resolveReceiptGroupIds};
    three file envelopes are the actual corresponding execution file envelopes.
    resolveReceiptGroupIds({rowKind,rowId,rowIndex,receiptRefs,releaseRef,
      receiptGroups,artifactFiles}) returns the ordered authenticated group IDs.
  sha256 = the already-reviewed pure UTF-8 SHA256 function.
  Resolved selectors always bind jsonValueSha256/jsonValueUtf8Bytes and a file
    envelope. Small exact values must match that JSON hash/byte count; large
    omitted values must carry the agreed authenticated file/pointer/value-hash
    reference. The assembler preserves that reference without materialization.
The function returns candidate ledger/SPEC bytes plus root-owned assignments.
It does not apply those aggregate assignments or publish anything.
Load: Function(source + "\nreturn assembleFinal27AndSpec;")()
